an2.11:1.6: kāyaduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañca, vacīduccaritassa pāpako vipāko diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañca, manoduccaritassa pāpako vipāko diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañcāti.
an2.11:1.7: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveti. vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveti, manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveti. suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati.
an2.11:2.2: tatra bhikkhave, yamidaṃ bhāvanābalaṃ. sekhametaṃ balaṃ.
an2.11:2.3: sekhaṃ hi so bhikkhave, balaṃ āgamma rāgaṃ pajahati, dosaṃ pajahati, mohaṃ pajahati.
an2.11:2.4: rāgaṃ pahāya, dosaṃ pahāya, mohaṃ pahāya yaṃ akusalaṃ, taṃ na karoti. yaṃ pāpaṃ, taṃ na sevati.
an2.12:1.6: kāyaduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañca. vacīduccaritassa pāpako vipāko diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañca. manoduccaritassa pāpako vipāko diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañcāti.
an2.12:1.7: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveti, vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveti, manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati.
an2.12:2.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vosaggapariṇāmiṃ.
an2.12:2.8: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vosaggapariṇāmiṃ.
an2.13:1.6: kāyaduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañca, vacīduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañca, manoduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañcāti.
an2.13:1.7: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveti, vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveti, manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati.
an2.13:2.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an2.13:2.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an2.13:2.4: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno, sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti, yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti, tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an2.13:2.5: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an2.14:1.4: imā kho bhikkhave, dve tathāgatassa dhammadesanāti.
an2.15:1.1: yasmiṃ bhikkhave, adhikaraṇe āpanno ca bhikkhu codako ca bhikkhu na sādhukaṃ attanāva attānaṃ paccavekkhati, tasmetaṃ bhikkhave, adhikaraṇe pāṭikaṅkhaṃ,
an2.15:1.2: dīghattāya kharattāya vāḷattāya saṃvattissati, bhikkhū ca na phāsukaṃ viharissantīti.
an2.15:1.3: yasmiṃ ca kho bhikkhave, adhikaraṇe āpanno ca bhikkhu codako ca bhikkhu sādhukaṃ attanāva attānaṃ paccavekkhati, tasmetaṃ bhikkhave, adhikaraṇe pāṭikaṅkhaṃ,
an2.15:1.4: na dīghattāya kharattāya vāḷattāya saṃvattissati, bhikkhū ca phāsukaṃ viharissantīti:
an2.15:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave āpanno bhikkhu sādhukaṃ attanāva attānaṃ paccavekkhati:
an2.15:2.2: idha bhikkhave āpanno bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati,
an2.15:2.3: ahaṃ kho akusalaṃ āpanno kañcideva desaṃ kāyena. taṃ
an2.15:2.4: maṃ so bhikkhu addasa akusalaṃ āpajjamānaṃ kañcideva desaṃ kāyena.
an2.15:2.5: no ce ahaṃ akusalaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ kañcideva desaṃ kāyena, na maṃ so bhikkhu passeyya akusalaṃ āpajjamānaṃ kañcideva desaṃ kāyena.
an2.15:2.6: yasmā ca kho ahaṃ akusalaṃ āpanno kañcideva desaṃ kāyena. tasmā maṃ so bhikkhu addasa akusalaṃ āpajjamānaṃ kañcideva desaṃ kāyena.
an2.15:2.7: disvā ca pana maṃ so bhikkhu akusalaṃ āpajjamānaṃ kañcideva desaṃ kāyena anattamano ahosi.
an2.15:2.8: anattamano samāno anattamanavacanaṃ maṃ so bhikkhu avaca.
an2.15:2.9: anattamanavacanāhaṃ tena bhikkhunā vutto samāno anattamano ahosiṃ.
an2.15:2.11: iti mameva tattha accayo accagamā suṅkadāyakaṃva bhaṇḍasminti.
an2.15:2.12: evaṃ kho bhikkhave āpanno bhikkhu sādhukaṃ attanāva attānaṃ paccavekkhati.
an2.15:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave codako bhikkhu sādhukaṃ attanāva attānaṃ paccavekkhati:
an2.15:3.2: idha bhikkhave codako bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati:
an2.15:3.3: ayaṃkho bhikkhu akusalaṃ āpanno kañcideva desaṃ kāyena.
an2.15:3.4: tāhaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ addasaṃ akusalaṃ āpajjamānaṃ kañcideva desaṃ kāyena.
an2.15:3.5: no ce ayaṃ bhikkhu akusalaṃ āpajjeyya kañcideva desaṃ kāyena, nāhaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ passeyyaṃ akusalaṃ āpajjamānaṃ kañcideva desaṃ kāyena.
an2.15:3.6: yasmā ca kho ayaṃ bhikkhu akusalaṃ āpanno kañcideva desaṃ kāyena, tasmā ahaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ addasaṃ akusalaṃ āpajjamānaṃ kañcideva desaṃ kāyena.
an2.15:3.7: disvā ca panāhaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ akusalaṃ āpajjamānaṃ kañcideva desaṃ kāyena, anattamano ahosiṃ.
an2.15:3.8: anattamano samāno anattamanavacanāhaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ avacaṃ.
an2.15:3.9: anattamanavacanāyaṃ bhikkhu mayā vutto samāno anattamano ahosi.
an2.15:3.11: iti mameva tattha accayo accagamā suṅkadāyakaṃva bhaṇḍasminti.
an2.15:3.12: evaṃ kho bhikkhave codako bhikkhu sādhukaṃ attanāva attānaṃ paccavekkhati.
an2.15:4.1: yasmiṃ bhikkhave adhikaraṇe āpanno ca bhikkhu codako ca bhikkhu na sādhukaṃ attanāva attānaṃ paccavekkhati, tasmetaṃ bhikkhave adhikaraṇe pāṭikaṅkhaṃ dīghattāya kharattāya vāḷattāya saṃvattissati. bhikkhū ca na phāsukaṃ viharissantīti.
an2.15:4.2: yasmiṃ ca kho bhikkhave adhikaraṇe āpanno ca bhikkhu codako ca bhikkhu sādhukaṃ attanāva attānaṃ paccavekkhati, tasmetaṃ bhikkhave adhikaraṇe pāṭikaṅkhaṃ na dīghattāya kharattāya vāḷattāya saṃvattissati. bhikkhū ca phāsukaṃ viharissantīti.
an2.16:1.1: atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
an2.16:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an2.16:1.3: ko nu kho bho gotama hetu, ko paccayo, yena midhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantīti?
an2.16:1.4: [bhagavā:] adhammacariyā visamacariyā hetu kho brāhmaṇa evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantīti.
an2.16:2.1: [brāhmaṇo:] ko pana bho gotama hetu, ko paccayo, yenamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti?
an2.16:2.2: [bhagavā:] dhammacariyā samacariyā hetu kho brāhmaṇa evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti.
an2.16:3.1: [brāhmaṇo:] abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama,
an2.16:3.2: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, ‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī’ti, evameva bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
an2.16:3.3: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
an2.16:3.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
an2.17:1.1: athakho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an2.17:1.2: -pe- ekamantaṃ nisinno kho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca.
an2.17:1.3: ko nu kho bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo, yena midhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantīti,
an2.17:1.5: evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantīti.
an2.17:1.6: [brāhmaṇo:] ko pana bho gotama hetu, ko paccayo, yena midhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti.
an2.17:1.8: evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti.
an2.17:1.9: [brāhmaṇo:] na kho ahaṃ imassa bhoto gotamassa saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
an2.17:1.10: sādhu me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu, yathā ahaṃ imassa bhoto gotamassa saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājāneyyanti.
an2.17:1.11: tena hi brāhmaṇa suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasi karohi, bhāsissāmīti.
an2.17:1.12: evambhoti kho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo bhagavato paccassosi:
an2.17:2.1: idha brāhmaṇa ekaccassa kāyaduccaritaṃ kataṃ hoti, akataṃ hoti kāyasucaritaṃ.
an2.17:2.2: vacīduccaritaṃ kataṃ hoti, akataṃ hoti vacīsucaritaṃ.
an2.17:2.3: manoduccaritaṃ kataṃ hoti, akataṃ hoti manosucaritaṃ.
an2.17:2.4: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa katattā ca akatattā ca evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
an2.17:2.5: idha pana brāhmaṇa ekaccassa kāyasucaritaṃ kataṃ hoti, akataṃ hoti kāyaduccaritaṃ,
an2.17:2.6: vacīsucaritaṃ kataṃ hoti, akataṃ hoti vacīduccaritaṃ.
an2.17:2.7: manosucaritaṃ kataṃ hoti, akataṃ hoti manoduccaritaṃ.
an2.17:2.8: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa katattā ca akatattā ca evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti.
an2.17:3.1: [brāhmaṇo:] abhikkantaṃ bho gotama -pe- upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
an2.18:1.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
an2.18:1.2: ekaṃsenāhaṃ ānanda akaraṇīyaṃ vadāmi kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritanti.
an2.18:1.3: [ānando:] yamidaṃ bhante bhagavatā ekaṃsena akaraṇīyaṃ akkhātaṃ kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ. tasmiṃ akaraṇīye kayiramāne ko ādīnavo pāṭikaṅkhoti.
an2.18:1.4: [bhagavā:] yamidaṃ ānanda mayā ekaṃsena akaraṇīyaṃ akkhātaṃ kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ. tasmiṃ akaraṇīye kayiramāne ayaṃ ādīnavo pāṭikaṅkho:
an2.18:1.9: kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
an2.18:1.10: yamidaṃ ānanda mayā ekaṃsena akaraṇīyaṃ akkhātaṃ kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ. tasmiṃ akaraṇīye kayiramāne ayaṃ ādīnavo pāṭikaṅkho.
an2.18:2.1: ekaṃsenāhaṃ ānanda karaṇīyaṃ vadāmi kāyasucaritaṃ vacīsucaritaṃ manosucaritanti.
an2.18:2.2: [ānando:] yamidaṃ bhante bhagavatā ekaṃsena karaṇīyaṃ akkhātaṃ kāyasucaritaṃ vacīsucaritaṃ manosucaritaṃ tasmiṃ karaṇīye kayiramāne ko ānisaṃso pāṭikaṅkhoti?
an2.18:2.3: [bhagavā:] yamidaṃ ānanda mayā ekaṃsena karaṇīyaṃ akkhātaṃ kāyasucaritaṃ vacīsucaritaṃ manosucaritaṃ. tasmiṃ karaṇīye kayiramāne ayaṃ ānisaṃso pāṭikaṅkho:
an2.18:2.8: kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
an2.18:2.9: yamidaṃ ānanda mayā ekaṃsena karaṇīyaṃ akkhātaṃ kāyasucaritaṃ vacīsucaritaṃ manosucaritaṃ. tasmiṃ karaṇīye kayiramāne ayaṃ ānisaṃso pāṭikaṅkhoti.
an2.19:1.3: no ce taṃ bhikkhave sakkā abhavissa akusalaṃ pajahituṃ, nāhaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ
an2.19:1.5: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave sakkā akusalaṃ pajahituṃ, tasmāhaṃ evaṃ vadāmi
an2.19:1.7: akusalaṃ ca hidaṃ bhikkhave pahīnaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvatteyya. nāhaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ
an2.19:1.9: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave akusalaṃ pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya saṃvattati, tasmāhaṃ evaṃ vadāmi
an2.19:2.3: no ce taṃ bhikkhave sakkā abhavissa kusalaṃ bhāvetuṃ, nāhaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ
an2.19:2.5: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave sakkā kusalaṃ bhāvetuṃ, tasmāhaṃ evaṃ vadāmi
an2.19:2.7: kusalaṃ ca hidaṃ bhikkhave bhāvitaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvatteyya, nāhaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ
an2.19:2.9: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave kusalaṃ bhāvitaṃ hitāya sukhāya saṃvattati tasmāhaṃ evaṃ vadāmi
an2.20:1.1: dve me bhikkhave dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattanti.
an2.20:1.4: dunnikkhittassa bhikkhave padabyañjanassa atthopi dunnayo hoti.
an2.20:1.5: ime kho bhikkhave dve dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattantīti.
an2.20:2.1: dve me bhikkhave dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattanti.
an2.20:2.4: sunikkhittassa bhikkhave padabyañjanassa atthopi sunayo hoti.
an2.20:2.5: ime kho bhikkhave dve dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattantīti.
